body.name: Coordinate-aligned repeated-sensor mechanism
body.construction: For every \(i\in V\), let \(U_i\) be centered Gaussian, and for every \(i\in V\) and \(a\in M\), let \(\eta_i^{(a)}\) be centered Gaussian with \(\operatorname{Var}(\eta_i^{(a)})>0\). Require the variables \((U_i)_{i\in V}\) to be mutually independent, the variables \((\eta_i^{(a)})_{i\in V,a\in M}\) to be mutually independent, and the two families to be independent. For deterministic loadings \(\lambda_{ia}\), set \(\varepsilon_i^{(a)}=\lambda_{ia}U_i+\eta_i^{(a)}\). Then the coordinate stacks are mutually independent and \(\Gamma_i=\operatorname{Var}(U_i)\lambda_i\lambda_i^{\mathsf T}+\operatorname{diag}_{a\in M}\operatorname{Var}(\eta_i^{(a)})\succ0\), where \(\lambda_i=(\lambda_{ia})_{a\in M}\).
